text:
evan: Heads-up from QA: samplekit JS + json_mode flakes when an auth refresh causes a mid-stream retry. Final assemble fails schema check.

priya: thanks. quick repro?

evAN: flow: start samplekit generate with `json_mode: true` and a streaming tool that emits array elements. Expire token mid-stream. SDK refreshes and retries the tail. The stitcher naively appends replayed fragments and we see broken joins like `][` so JSON.parse fails.

carter: yikes. can you paste a log excerpt?

evAN: pasted log:
```
INFO chunk: "\n]"
INFO auth: token refresh started
INFO retrying stream request
INFO chunk (replay): "[\n{\"k\":1}\n"
ERROR schema-validator: Unexpected token ']' at position 1
```

priya: this smells like two problems: (1) stitcher state persists across retries, (2) no replay detection. Short-term we can make the parser tolerant for stray separators in json_mode. Long-term we should add explicit stream session ids or use framed messages.

carter: agreed. i propose: A) emit `x-stream-session-id` header at stream start and increment `chunk-index` on each fragment so replayed chunks carry indexes. B) on client stitcher, if you see a replay (same session id but lower/equal index) either reset or skip duplicates. C) add unit tests that simulate replayed prefixes.

priya: also add an observability event when auth-refresh+retry occurs so logs show stream restart boundaries. That will help customers and oncall.

evan: i'll file the issue and attach QA session. carter, can you add the unit tests to sdk-js and include a doc note in samplekit README?

carter: yes. test will simulate: send initial stream pieces `[\n{\"a\":1}\n` then simulate retry that replays `[\n{\"b\":2}\n` and assert final assembled output equals `[{\"a\":1},{\"b\":2}]`. i'll also implement a guard: if `x-retry` header present, reset buffer before concatenation.

priya: we should also audit sdk-py and sdk-ts for the same stitcher pattern. parity bug is likely.

qa-bot: opened issue #5120: "streaming json_mode: auth-refresh retry -> stitcher concat error" (assignees: carter, priya)

evAN: thanks team. adding a troubleshooting blurb to samplekit docs so early users don't get blocked.
